title: pinus jaliscana subsp. macvaughii
intro: Pinus jaliscana subsp. macvaughii, commonly known as the MacVaugh's Mexican pine, is a subspecies of pine tree native to Mexico. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Pinus jaliscana subsp. macvaughii include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antifungal properties, which make it effective in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
